name_reason: Compliant game-global name: data_fd2_ prefix, domain 'animation_palette_cycle', descriptor 'frame_idx' accurately reflects a frame-index/counter. No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix tied to its own/any address). Use confirmed by sole accessor fd2_update_palette_cycle_anim @ 0x4DFCC: INC byte ptr [0x60002]; CMP byte ptr [0x60002],0x10; reset to 0; MOV AL,[0x60002] then *3 to index the RGB table.
purpose: Current frame index (0..15) of the 16-frame VGA palette-cycle animation (water/lava/fire) driven by fd2_update_palette_cycle_anim.
logic_summary: On each throttled advance (>=2 BIOS ticks), the sole accessor does frame_idx++, wraps to 0 when it reaches 0x10, then computes offset = frame_idx*3 as the sliding-window start into data_fd2_animation_palette_cycle_rgb_table (0x60003) and re-outputs 16 RGB triplets to palette entries 0xE0..0xEF via ports 0x3C8/0x3C9.
element_semantics: Single byte holding the live animation frame index, valid range 0..15 (kept in range by the increment-then-wrap-at-16 logic). Scaled by 3 to select the per-frame RGB window. Confirmed 8-bit by every access being byte-sized (INC byte ptr, CMP byte ptr, MOV byte ptr, MOV AL).
notes: Mutable runtime counter (is_const=false): game writes it via INC/MOV-0 in fd2_update_palette_cycle_anim (xrefs to 0x60002 include WRITE at 0x4DFEF and READ_WRITE at 0x4DFE0). src comment block (palette.c lines 29-42) was already precise and ASCII -- documents purpose, increment/wrap-at-16 logic, *3 RGB-window scaling, uint8 type rationale with disasm evidence, and zero-init .object3 rationale -- so comment_verdict=keep and no Edit made (working tree clean). Ghidra plate_action=none: the consuming function's plate and the in-decompiler symbol name already match my understanding with no contradiction, so per workflow rule the data plate is left untouched.
